name: Gearing Redridge
summary: In Lakeshire, a hard pressed garrison needs sturdy copper gear from Ironforge. Tormus Deepforge asks aspiring Alliance smiths to forge it and aid Verner Osgood as he helps defend the region from hostile orcs and gnolls.

sections.title: A Plea Across Kingdoms
sections.body: The Great Forge sends help beyond Dun Morogh, where the Alliance's front line is under strain. In the Redridge Mountains, Lakeshire faces repeated attacks from Blackrock orcs marching from Stonewatch Keep and gnolls roaming the northern ridges. Stormwind's royal reinforcements are slow to arrive, and local supplies are dangerously low.

sections.title: The Anvils of Lakeshire
sections.body: Verner Osgood, Lakeshire's resident blacksmith, works nearly alone at his outdoor forge. He mends shattered armor and replaces broken weapons. Seeing his human counterpart under strain, Tormus Deepforge asks developing smiths to bring four Runed Copper Belts and four Heavy Copper Mauls to Lakeshire. The gear strengthens the militia's reserves, and Verner teaches traveling craftsmen finer trade techniques.

faq.q: Who starts the Gearing Redridge quest?
faq.answer: At Ironforge's Great Forge, Tormus Deepforge offers the work to Alliance smiths skilled enough in their trade.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire need weapons and armor from Ironforge?
faq.answer: Lakeshire faces constant attacks from Blackrock orcs occupying Stonewatch Keep and aggressive gnolls in the northern ridges. Verner Osgood is overwhelmed, mending arms and armor for the militia alone.

faq.q: Who receives the shipment in Redridge?
aliases: where to turn in gearing redridge
faq.answer: Verner Osgood, Lakeshire's local blacksmith, receives the shipment near the forge in the lakeside town.

faq.q: What equipment must be forged for the task?
faq.answer: Forge four Runed Copper Belts and four Heavy Copper Mauls. Together, they call for skill in protective plating and heavy striking craft.

faq.q: What threats are troubling Redridge at this time?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch Keep, while violent gnoll packs prowl the northern foothills around Lakeshire.

faq.q: What reward does Verner Osgood offer in return?
faq.answer: Once Verner is freed from outfitting every guardsman from scratch, he teaches you finer blacksmithing techniques.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you show you can make durable weapons and protective armor in quantity for an active warfront.
As an Alliance member, you carry aid from Ironforge to the hard pressed human townships of the south, where Stormwind's divided leadership has been slow to act.
As a dwarf, you draw on a craft that sustains the Alliance war effort. Tormus directs Ironforge's finest smiths to aid their allies.
As a human of the southern kingdoms, you receive metalwork forged in Khaz Modan, bringing relief from the aggressive Blackrock remnants.
